scope: Historical initial review of isolated future NEW CPU-process ledger adapter; parent subsequently fixed it before this report was published. This report binds only the preserved reviewed version.

findings.title: Scope teardown races an active audit and admits overlapping scopes
findings.impact: The original finally block restores the original function and unregisters without call_lock. A background adapted audit can outlive its scope; a second scope can start another two-worker collector, reaching four active verifiers and appending a success receipt after scope exit.
findings.fix: Acquire the same call_lock during teardown; restore/unregister only after active audit completion, retaining installation registration while waiting. Add a threaded lifecycle regression and verify a saved callback is rejected after teardown.

verified_strengths: Ten fresh source completions per invocation through the accepted collect_fresh; no cross-invocation receipt memoization.
Original audit consumes one-use configuration-bound FreshLookup; exact supported JSON ledger comparison excludes only top-level utc.
Caller verifier/config mismatch, supplied pin drift, missing reference pin, ordinary worker errors and nested installation are rejected; synchronous restoration works.
generic_adapter_integration_boundary: The generic library takes injected queue, verifier, canonical-ID/reference selectors and pin map. It requires configuration/reference pins and enforces all supplied pins, but the concrete future entry must establish exact ORIGINAL functions and complete approved 20-source plus canonical input pins. That entry is not yet written or accepted; its completeness is not a missing generic-library feature.
declined_to_judge: Concrete future CPU entry, complete canonical pin-map admission, actual pair-context equivalence, full role PNG byte/RGB results, resource admission and end-to-end speed: separate future validation.
Production integration, target scoring/export authority, primary 20-source edits, running owner health or original seed7 admission outcome: outside isolated review scope.
